dogecoin.text: 4/5 But that’s because I believe in them. You don’t need to agree with my picks, you can be an $ADA $SOL $DOGE $XRP fan.. if your belief is that this is the future then why worry when markets tumble? Ride out the wave and just keep doing what you were doing

For all those in meme coins $DOGE $SHIB etc .. my only recommendation is don’t get greedy.. you don’t want to have a dead meme coin in a crash because as fast as you go up is as fast as you go down.. you will be relying on a shit pump vs hold something with value that’ll recover

Not a meme coin person but #dogecoin did peak retail interest which brought more people in crypto so I’m here for it
